path_policy: Resolve these paths before each command; the canonical work root is this project tree. Do not write outside declared work/save/delivery roots without an explicit reason.

delivery_scope.runtime_vendor_code: Only the minimal code/configuration/assets required for currently wired specialist adapters are retained; upstream repositories/tests, training corpora, legacy database fragments and historical savepoints are excluded.

deliverables.purpose: Standalone Python-standard-library runtime core, local CLI/GUI, required minimal specialist runtime payloads, examples, schemas and user guides.
Audit reports, receipts, provenance/hash inventories, validation logs and formal revision evidence; no historical source repositories.
Phase/error checklists, paths, tests, scripts, benchmarks, formal documents and reproducible evidence; no historical source repositories.

delivery_scope.publication: Not performed. The release is staged for the user to decide and publish independently.
delivery_scope.known_source_gap: The historical eGenBrain legacy database is PARTIAL because part02 was absent from the supplied archive. No replacement bytes have been fabricated.
delivery_scope.final_validation: Detached P13_clean_extraction_validation.json and release_manifest.json contain exact final archive hashes to avoid self-referential ZIP hashes.
